figurative_meaning_en: Child born to an unmarried woman
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এক কানীন সন্তান হিসেবে জন্মেছে।
মহাভারতে কর্ণকে কানীন বলে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He was born as an illegitimate child.
In the Mahabharata, Karna is referred to as kanin.
history: Refers to Karna, the son of Kunti from the Mahabharata epic, who was born to her before marriage through divine intervention.
note: The term also has a secondary meaning as a concise expression, but the idiomatic usage primarily draws from mythology.
